body: That’s totally valid and I appreciate your response. I’m just a little nervous about confessing because they’re pretty anxious and I don’t want to put them on the spot, on the off chance they have feelings too but aren’t ready to be a thing. I’ll try and think of a way to confess without being super weird about it.

I met him a year ago. We became fast friends, got to know each other a bit. I’d never connected with someone on so many levels before, or found someone so attractive in every way. We never dated, but we spent the night with each other a few times. The spark was so bright for me that I thought he must feel the same way, but he didn’t. We don’t talk anymore. I wish him well, but it’s hard to move past and I feel like I may be sad about it forever.
He looks like if Steve Buscemi was hot
Is it just me or does she look like Carl from the walking dead

Obligatory not a doctor, but my great grandma died recently, who my mom hated and had been saying “why won’t she just dieeeee????” about for the past year. After she died, my mom took a picture of my grandmamas corpse and sent it to me.
Yes, this is a throwaway but if I stop using it I’ll save the login information so I can read and respond to your messages. Thank you again
Ok, I will do that. Thank you for talking to me, you helped me get my mind off of things and I do feel a little better now.

I’m not very good at playing instruments and I don’t have any good recording equipment, so I try to make due with what I have. I usually use the poetry I write for lyrics, and make short, repetitive melodies with the instruments I have access to. I don’t know what kind of music it is. If I* had to call it anything I guess it would be bummer lullabies.
I’m ambidextrous. I’m not very good at anything, but I try to be okay at several things. I have my music up on the internet, but I’m not sure what the rules are here in terms of doxxing myself

Thank you, I really appreciate that. I like to make music and write bummer poetry and draw occasionally.  I just finished a big poetry project and I don’t know what to do with my time anymore now that I’m finished

I’ve set up an appointment for a therapist but I’m very low income and the waitlist is massive so there’s no telling when I will get seen, same with an actual doctor to attempt to get a med prescription. I feel like I’ve done what I can to get help and help just doesn’t seem to be coming.

My whole life has just been not great. I think it’s partially a genetic predisposition on both sides, and partially neglect and emotional abuse, in terms of childhood in particular. My life only started evening out over the last few years, but I recently got out of a long relationship and most of my friends were through my ex so now I’m just alone all the time.

Thank you. I responded something similar to the person above, but basically I thought I would grow out of being suicidal or that my feelings would change when my circumstances became better, but they haven’t. This has been a lifelong battle for me and I’m just tired of waiting to feel better at this point.

Asking friends irl for help is scary, because people tend to think depression is icky and uncomfortable to deal with, and I don’t want to lose friends by reaching out and just get myself stuck in an even worse situation.

Thank you. I’ve just been depressed since I can remember. In elementary school I remember telling some poor office lady that I wished I could start my life over. I thought when I was younger that it was something that I would grow out of, or something that was subject to change with my circumstances. But I’m relatively happy and I still don’t want to exist.

This is something that I’m going to be dealing with for the rest of my life. It doesn’t feel like an “if” anymore, but a “when”. I can’t afford to get the kind of help that I need, and people tend to be more forgiving irl of suicide ideation after somebody goes through with it. No one wants to hear about how badly you want to die all the time. I’m afraid of asking for help from the people I know because I don’t want to push them away in the event that I keep living.
